title: Left Claude Code running for 1 days and came back to finished work
description:
Left Claude Code running for 1 days and came back to finished work.

/dynamic-workflows spun up the agents,

/ultra-plan drafted the next tasks in the cloud,
/schedule fired the whole thing on its own 🔥

Chain all four and you stop babysitting the terminal.
